run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T17:16:33Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by failures originating in the ad service that propagate up the request path. From about 17:23-17:25Z ad's own server spans for oteldemo.AdService/GetAds are STATUS_CODE_ERROR (0.16935/s ERROR vs 0.02664/s UNSET in the 10m to 17:40:26Z, i.e. roughly 86% of its GetAds spans failed). Those failures are fast, not timeouts: of 101.61 failed ad GetAds spans in the 10m window, 86.77 finished within 10ms and 74.21 within 2ms. The ad container repeatedly logs an uncaught gRPC exception ('Exception while executing runnable io.grpc.internal.ServerImpl$JumpToApplicationThreadServerStreamListener$1HalfClosed@...'), absent from the 16:50-17:00 and 17:00-17:12 reads and present 453 times in the 17:05-17:40 read (newest 17:31:27.741Z). The frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds errors at the same rate and its /api/data route fails, so frontend-proxy returns HTTP 500 '- via_upstream' on /api/data while serving 200s for products, recommendations, cart and checkout on the same pod. That produces frontend-proxy ingress/egress ERROR spans (0.17506/s ingress, 0.16935/s egress) and the alert. The ad pod was Running and Ready with restartCount 0, no lastState and no events, so this is not a crash, eviction or OOM. Ad container CPU usage and CFS throttling rose in the same minutes (usage ~0.009-0.019 cores before 17:23, 0.0428 at 17:24; throttled periods 6.6-19.9% before, 33.9-56.2% from 17:24; JVM CPU ratio up to 0.699), which is coincident with, not established as the cause of, the fast per-request failures. Pre-incident traces at 16:59:55-16:59:59 show ad GetAds returning rpc.grpc.status_code=0 in 1.4-2.6ms with frontend/proxy responses 200/308. The deepest cause the evidence supports is the ad Deployment's own GetAds handling; whether a flagd fault flag (adFailure/adHighCpu/adManualGc exist with defaultVariant off in flagd-config) or a code-level exception in the ad container is responsible could not be determined from readable data.

claims.text: At 17:40:26Z frontend-proxy's own span error rates were: span_name 'ingress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0.17506/s with STATUS_CODE_UNSET 2.38615/s, and span_name 'router frontend egress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0.16935/s with STATUS_CODE_UNSET 2.39186/s (10m rates).

A 10m error-span query at 17:40:26Z returned nonzero STATUS_CODE_ERROR series only for frontend 'GET', frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds', frontend 'executing api route (pages) /api/data', frontend 'GET /api/data', ad 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (0.16935/s), ad 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' (0.0019/s) and frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' and 'ingress'; the other series in that result (frontend cart/checkout routes, payment, accounting, recommendation flagd stream) were 0.
ad's own server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds had 10m rate 0.16935/s with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR and 0.02664/s with STATUS_CODE_UNSET at 17:40:26Z.

The failed ad GetAds spans were short: for the 10m ending 17:40:26Z the cumulative duration buckets of traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="ad",span_name="oteldemo.AdService/GetAds",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} were le=2ms 74.21, le=4ms 83.34, le=10ms 86.77, le=100ms 95.90, le=1000ms 101.61 and +Inf 101.61.

The corresponding frontend client failures were also short: traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="frontend",span_name="grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} over the 10m ending 17:40:26Z gave le=2ms 11.42, le=4ms 68.50, le=10ms 77.64, le=100ms 87.91, +Inf 99.33.

ad GetAds errors began around 17:23-17:25Z: sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="ad",span_name="oteldemo.AdService/GetAds",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[3m])) was 0 at 17:24:00Z, 92.73 at 17:25:00Z and 118.8 at 17:26:00Z; in the 5m rate view the ERROR series first appears at 17:25:33Z (0.3987/s) while the UNSET series falls from about 0.83-1.09/s up to 17:23:33Z to 0.0674/s at 17:35:33Z.

frontend-proxy's error-span share of its own spans rose sharply from 17:23-17:24Z: sum(rate(frontend-proxy error spans[5m]))/sum(rate(all frontend-proxy spans[5m]))*100 was 0 at 17:23:00Z, 1.62 at 17:24:00Z, 3.47 at 17:25:00Z, 6.82 at 17:27:00Z, 7.76 at 17:32:00Z and 5.46 at 17:36:00Z.

The ad container repeatedly logs an uncaught gRPC exception: 'Exception while executing runnable io.grpc.internal.ServerImpl$JumpToApplicationThreadServerStreamListener$1HalfClosed@<id>'. In the 17:05:00-17:40:26 read there were 453 matching lines with the newest at 2026-11-16T17:31:27.741Z, and in the 17:00-17:25 read there were 125 matching lines, newest five at 17:24:51.966-17:24:56.950Z.

frontend-proxy's access log shows the failing request path: at 17:24:49.712Z 'GET /api/data?contextKeys=accessories HTTP/1.1' 500 - via_upstream (upstream frontend), with further 500s for contextKeys=assembly and travel, while in the same seconds '/api/products/... 200', '/api/recommendations?... 200', 'POST /api/cart 200' and 'POST /api/checkout 200' were served; 328 lines matching '" 500 "' were read in 17:25:00-17:40:26 with the newest at 17:31:27.612Z.

The ad pod was not crashed or restarted: pod ad-554b849958-sk6fg is phase Running, container 'ad' ready=true with restartCount 0, empty lastState, container started 2026-11-16T16:46:20Z; its ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 is owned by Deployment 'ad' and has 1/1 ready replicas.

Ad container CPU use and throttling rose at the same time as the errors: rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{pod="ad-554b849958-sk6fg"}) was 0.0093-0.0192 cores in the 17:00-17:22 samples, then 0.0428 at 17:24:00Z and 0.0227-0.0333 afterwards; throttled CFS periods were 6.6-19.9% up to 17:22, then 56.2% at 17:24:00Z and 33.9-47.5% afterwards; jvm_cpu_recent_utilization_ratio for exported_job opentelemetry-demo/ad went from 0.24-0.42 to 0.699 at 17:24:00Z and 0.459-0.542 later.

The otel-demo ConfigMap flagd-config defines ad-related fault flags adFailure ('Fail ad service'), adHighCpu ('Triggers high cpu load in the ad service') and adManualGc ('Triggers full manual garbage collections in the ad service'), all with state ENABLED and defaultVariant 'off'; the ad Deployment runs image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad with FLAGD_HOST=flagd and container resources limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi, requests cpu 10m / memory 225Mi.

Before the failure the ad path was healthy in traces: a 16:59:55-16:59:59 sample shows ad oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans with rpc.grpc.status_code="0" and durations 1406-2591us, with frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator spans at HTTP 200/308.

Over the 30m ending 17:40:26Z the only error-span increases were frontend GET / grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds / GET /api/data / executing api route (pages) /api/data (487.90 each), ad oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (473.60), frontend-proxy router frontend egress (489.62) and ingress (506.86), plus small flagd EventStream counts on ad (2.03), recommendation (2.03) and fraud-detection (3.04).

frontend-proxy is relaying an upstream failure rather than originating it: its ingress ERROR rate (0.17506/s) matches its egress ERROR rate to the frontend (0.16935/s), and its 500 lines carry the '- via_upstream' upstream-failure flag against upstream 'frontend'.

ad's flagd EventStream already had an ERROR span before the incident (grpc code 4, start 2026-11-16T16:52:53Z), and the 30m flagd-EventStream increases are only 2.03 (ad), 2.03 (recommendation) and 3.04 (fraud-detection) versus ~474 failed ad GetAds spans, so that stream-level error churn is not tied to this failure.

No error spans were returned for cart, checkout, payment, product-catalog, recommendation, shipping, currency, email, kafka, load-generator or image-provider in the 30m and 10m error queries, so the observed failure is confined to the ad call path (absence of a series is not proof of zero, and those services' own latency/health were not otherwise examined).

Rejected: the ad pod crashed, was OOM-killed, evicted or restarted. The pod is Running and Ready, the ad container has restartCount 0 and an empty lastState, and the ad ReplicaSet shows 1/1 ready with Deployment 'ad' as owner.

Rejected: the errors are client deadline/timeout responses. ad's failed GetAds spans had le=10ms 86.77 of 101.61 and the frontend's failed client GetAds spans had le=4ms 68.50 of 99.33, so the failures returned in milliseconds rather than after a deadline.

Primary hypothesis: the fault originates in the ad Deployment's GetAds handling, which throws an uncaught exception per request so the gRPC call fails immediately (fast ERROR spans plus the repeated 'Exception while executing runnable io.grpc.internal.ServerImpl$JumpToApplicationThreadServerStreamListener$1HalfClosed@...' log line), and the frontend's /api/data then returns 500, which frontend-proxy reports as its own ingress/egress error. Whether the thrower is a flagd-driven fault flag (adFailure) or a code defect could not be established.

Second candidate: CPU contention on the ad container contributes to the failures. The ad container is limited to 50m CPU and its usage, JVM CPU ratio and CFS throttling all rose from about 17:24Z, but the failed calls returned in 2-10ms rather than after queueing delays and the CPU rise could be a consequence of the failing path, so causality is not established.

Third candidate: a runtime change to flagd's flag state (not the ConfigMap defaults) enabled an ad fault at about 17:23Z. flagd-config lists adFailure/adHighCpu/adManualGc with defaultVariant 'off', but flagd-ui can change flags in memory, and neither flagd's logs nor any flag-evaluation metric was readable, so this could not be verified.

gaps: Jaeger data ends around 2026-11-16T17:00:39Z: the frontend-proxy trace sample's data_as_of was 17:00:39 and an ad trace search for 17:20:00-17:40:26Z returned no traces, so no trace covers the actual failure window; the failing requests are evidenced only by span metrics and pod logs.

The alerting rule 'RequestErrorRate' is not loaded/visible in the queried Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules returned no rules, status no_data), so its expression, window and the annotation value 2.1111111111111107 (threshold stated 'above 0') could not be verified; span-metric error ratios I computed were about 6.6-6.8% of frontend-proxy spans at 17:40:26Z.

The alert's stated start 2026-11-16T17:16:33Z precedes the observed onset of ad GetAds errors (first error increase in the 3m window ending 17:25:00Z; frontend-proxy error ratio 0 at 17:23:00Z) by roughly 7 minutes; the reason for the difference is unknown.

Runtime flag state could not be read: the flagd pod flagd-5667b74b84-vlt8x returned no log lines (status no_data), no flagd/flag-evaluation metric names exist in the queried Prometheus, and only three scrape jobs (kube-state-metrics, kubelet, otel-collector) are present; the flagd-config ConfigMap shows only defaults ('off') and cannot prove runtime flag state.
The frontend container's own logs returned no lines for 17:10-17:40:26Z (status no_data, 0 bytes read), so the frontend's error message or deadline for the failing GetAds calls could not be read.

The exact trigger inside the ad service (which exception, thrown where, flag-driven or not) is not determinable: ad's log line has no stack trace or exception class, no ad traces exist after about 17:00:39Z, and no ad GC counters or rpc_* metrics exist (rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count returned no_data) to separate adFailure from adHighCpu/adManualGc.

Kubernetes events for the otel-demo namespace returned nothing (status no_data; events may have expired with null timestamps), and all 21 otel-demo pods show start times of 16:46-16:48Z with restartCount 0, i.e. a namespace-wide rollout/deploy before the error onset whose reason is unknown because the change_history integration is not available; it cannot be placed as affected or as changed for another stated reason.

frontend-proxy log reading was cut by the 4 MiB read limit (read through 17:24:52Z in the first read and 17:31:27Z in later reads, one read status no_data), so 500 lines beyond those cut points are unknown; the readable frontend-proxy stream ends at 17:31:27Z.

Some queries returned no_data and therefore prove nothing about absence: traces_search for service 'ad' and for frontend-proxy exceeded the result size (RESULT_TOO_LARGE) and were not re-read in full, and traces_search_by_tags with error=true returned nothing for service 'ad' and 'frontend' in 17:00-17:40Z and 17:25-17:40Z windows, so the sampled trace evidence is limited and cannot be treated as a complete call chain.
next_steps: Read the actual exception class and status the ad service returns (the current ad log carries only the 'Exception while executing runnable ...' header) by capturing a stack dump or raising gRPC/application log verbosity for the ad container.

Check the live flagd flag state for adFailure, adHighCpu and adManualGc through the flagd-ui/API rather than the flagd-config ConfigMap defaults, since a runtime override is the most likely way an ad fault was enabled without a manifest change.
Review the ad container's 50m CPU limit and its throttling (33.9-56.2% of CFS periods from 17:24Z) together with the failing code path.

Locate the RequestErrorRate rule in the Prometheus instance that actually owns it to reconcile its stated 17:16:33Z start and the reported value 2.1111 with the span-metric error ratios observed here.
Retain Jaeger/span samples covering the 17:20-17:40Z failure window (or extend trace retention) so the failing frontend to ad call path can be inspected span by span.
